meta.name: cobrapy
meta.description: Constraint-based metabolic modeling (COBRA). FBA, FVA, gene knockouts, flux sampling, SBML models, for systems biology and metabolic engineering analysis.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用约束模型计算代谢网络通量,预测基因敲除带来的影响
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果要用约束模型研究代谢网络、做通量或基因敲除分析。
copy.tagline_en: Model metabolic networks to compute fluxes and predict gene knockout effects
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you study metabolic networks with constraint-based models.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 能用 Python 的 cobrapy 库读取和导出基因组尺度代谢模型(SBML/JSON/YAML),运行 FBA、FVA、基因敲除和通量采样,输出生长速率、通量范围、必需基因等结果。
howto.when: 当你要求加载或导出代谢模型、运行 FBA/FVA、做基因或反应敲除等分析时触发。

say.text: 加载 textbook 模型,跑一次 FBA 看生长速率
say.note: 返回目标值和各反应通量

say.text: 对 iJO1366 做单基因敲除,列出生长下降的基因
say.note: 输出敲除后生长变化结果

say.text: 算这个模型的最小培养基需要哪些组分
say.note: 返回培养基组分及用量

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude can read and export genome-scale metabolic models (SBML/JSON/YAML) with the Python cobrapy library, run FBA, FVA, gene knockouts and flux sampling, and report growth rates, flux ranges and essential genes.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to load or export a metabolic model, run FBA/FVA, or do gene or reaction knockout analyses, etc.

say_en.text: Load the textbook model and run FBA to see the growth rate
Run single gene deletion on iJO1366 and list genes with lower growth
Compute the minimal medium components for this model
